candidates.title: MoEless: Efficient MoE LLM Serving via Serverless Computing
candidates.reason: expert load imbalanceをlayer-aware predictorで予測し、straggler expertをserverless resourceへproactive scale/placementするelastic MoE serving。8-GPU testbedでlatency 43%、cost 84%削減を報告し、static expert placement/offloadとは異なるresource elasticity軸を持つ。

candidates.title: Token-Budget-Aware Pool Routing for Cost-Efficient LLM Inference
candidates.reason: worst-case contextで全vLLM instanceを設定するconfiguration-traffic mismatchを、short/longの異なるpoolとonline token-budget推定で解消する軽量routing。Azure/LMSYS tracesでGPU instance 17〜39%削減を報告し、複雑なschedulerではなくfleet configurationとroutingの境界を扱う。
